queries.contrast: SELECT p.entity_name, p.sic_code, p.sic_description_reference, f.period_end, f.value_usd AS revenue, f.fiscal_year, f.fiscal_period FROM edgar.apple_revenue_table f JOIN edgar.apple_profile_table p ON f.cik = p.cik WHERE f.fiscal_period = 'FY' UNION ALL SELECT p.entity_name, p.sic_code, p.sic_description_reference, f.period_end, f.value_usd AS revenue, f.fiscal_year, f.fiscal_period FROM edgar.walmart_revenue_table f JOIN edgar.walmart_profile_table p ON f.cik = p.cik WHERE f.fiscal_period = 'FY' ORDER BY fiscal_year, entity_name
queries.margins: SELECT DISTINCT r.period_start, r.period_end, r.value_usd AS revenue, n.value_usd AS net_income FROM edgar.apple_revenue_table r JOIN edgar.apple_netincome_table n ON n.period_start = r.period_start AND n.period_end = r.period_end ORDER BY r.period_end
queries.profile: SELECT cik, entity_name, sic_code, sic_description_edgar, sic_description_reference, division, division_desc, major_group, major_group_desc, industry_group, industry_group_desc FROM edgar.apple_profile_table
